Topic.label: Implementing simple random sampling (drawing lots and random numbers)

Question: To select 5 students from 50 students numbered 1 to 50, how should the method of drawing lots be carried out? Which of the following procedures is correct?

Choices.A: Have the teacher choose 5 students considered representative
Choices.B: Directly select the students numbered 1 to 5
Choices.C: Write only the numbers 1 to 10 on slips of paper and draw 5 slips
Choices.D: Write each of the 50 numbers on a separate slip of paper of the same size and shape, mix them thoroughly, and randomly draw 5 slips

Solution: Drawing lots requires a slip for every individual, identical slips that are thoroughly mixed, and random selection. This gives everyone an equal chance of being selected.

Original.prompt: 从编号 1～50 的 50 名学生中抽取 5 人，用抽签法应怎样做？下列做法正确的是

choices.text: 让老师挑选 5 名认为有代表性的学生
直接选编号 1～5 的学生
只把编号 1～10 写成纸签，从中抽 5 张
把 50 个编号分别写在大小形状相同的纸签上，充分搅匀后随机抽出 5 张

Original.explanation: 抽签法要求所有个体都有纸签，纸签完全相同并充分搅匀，随机抽取，这样每人被抽到的机会均等。
